sizes.label: Small
sizes.title: Value Framework
sizes.text: A Value Framework activation: maturity assessment, competitive analysis, KPI planning, and a value-focused framework to build the case before committing to the move. Delivered as a focused Integrated Services activation, one at a time.

sizes.label: Medium
sizes.title: Modernization + Roadmap Development
sizes.text: A Modernization activation to assess your current Adobe Analytics implementation, data, and architecture and prepare the CJA migration, paired with Roadmap Development to sequence a phased, prioritized plan. Delivered as focused Integrated Services activations.

sizes.label: Large
sizes.title: Development Validation, then Feature Configuration / Capability Deployment
sizes.text: Development Validation to lock the technical requirements, architecture, and Business Requirements Document, then Feature Configuration / Capability Deployment to stand up and activate CJA. Delivered as focused Integrated Services activations.

capabilities.label: Connected Data
capabilities.description: Ingest event-level data from every source and query it in seconds, without pre-aggregation delays.

capabilities.label: Graph-Based Stitching
capabilities.description: Resolve every identity, on any channel or device, into a single connected view of the person.

capabilities.label: Data Transformations
capabilities.description: Reshape, correct, or enrich data at report time, without waiting on a re-implementation.

capabilities.label: Journey Mapping Visualization
capabilities.description: See exactly where people move, stall, or drop out of a journey, across every touchpoint.

capabilities.label: Attribution
capabilities.description: Compare multi-touch attribution models using fully stitched, cross-channel data.

capabilities.label: Experimentation Analysis
capabilities.description: Measure the lift and confidence of any test, from any source, in one place.

capabilities.label: AI Capabilities
capabilities.description: Ask questions in plain language, surface anomalies automatically, and let AI do the heavy analytical lifting.

capabilities.label: Content Analytics
capabilities.description: Automatically tag and analyze content performance without manual setup.
